metadata.title: Black Bridges
metadata.description: Secure the fortress branch against Wither Skeleton patrols.

tracker.text: Defeat 5 Wither Skeletons along the route.
Bring 32 Nether bricks for route markers.
Bring 16 Nether Wart for the route chest.

offer.label: Black Bridges
lines: The fortress bearing is true, but Wither Skeletons have found the same bridges.
Clear the patrol and build markers from the fortress's own black brick.
Defeat 5 Wither Skeletons and bring 32 Nether bricks and 16 Nether Wart. I will make the reward worth the trouble.
